correctness.rationale: The exact root-split model parameterization is injective for fixed d,c, and its size is algebraically 2^(ceil(c/2)+ceil((d-c)/2)). Separate near-full-length models with central cuts have at least delta*n-2 conflicting partner vertices. These give at least (delta*n-2)/2 distinct cross-component second-matching edges. On contraction of the first size<=2 matching, maximum degree two ensures at least half that many component mergers. Hence pair intersections are exponentially negligible after fixed L,delta, and Bonferroni + geometric-series upper bound prove parity-sensitive leading constants. Standalone finite independent predicate, model construction and OEIS checks passed; these do not replace the proof.
